speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: You slept the lesson. If you heard anything after it, keep it. I do not want it at the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not tell you that I heard it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Leave the cuff. The street is short, and the Sadlers have seen ink. Dinner is the next thing, and it is not a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we go. This pew is finished. Dinner is at noon, and I am not making a courtesy of the door.
